tests.description: Story 14.4 real command/checked RPC RED acceptance: preview receipt, complete selective workflow, exact no-op, atomic audit, replay and role isolation.
acceptance_criteria_covered: AC3 INT-002 atomic selected complete logical acceptance/audit
AC4 INT-005 unchanged identity survives/changed reopens
AC6 equal explicit lost-response replay and retry after rollback
AC7 current-role, Montor own rows, cross-tenant references, direct-RPC review gate/private ACLs
red_reasons: Sanitized editor-preview browser receipt is not implemented; private detector preview currently exposes whole-tenant row output.
Current create snapshot generates UUID per attempt rather than accepting stable proposed create identity.
Reviewed decision command fields/PREVIEW_STALE/BOOKING_CONFLICT_UNACKNOWLEDGED and authenticated SQL whole-group acceptance do not exist.
Current saveWithConflicts silently retries stale private proof; reviewed saves must instead require explicit renewed review.
Current digest only canonical booking facts; normalized review/selection/reason identity is future work.
Test-owned loader deliberately throws until actual adapters are supplied; collection skip is not a behavioral pass.

fixture_files.description: Typed TEST-OWNED engineering adapter and explicit fail-closed loader; no fabricated production export, HTTP endpoint, signature verification or success.

fixture_needs: Bind preview/save/read to actual production files and current command envelope when implemented, retaining raw browser payload and real error codes; do not install dependencies.

seedMixed: isolated tenant pairs through withConflictFixture; >=4 same-person booking participants, stable candidate sorts third; >=2 candidate logical groups, unrelated A/foreign B conflicts, own and coworker-only read controls. Independent expected full logical identity and every v1/v2 natural key must derive from literal fixture data/sole-engine identity BEFORE persistence translation, never row endpoint inference or output under test.

Separate genuine review receipt signer/verifier with domain distinct from elpro.booking-conflicts.attestation.v1 and complete claims tenant/actor/operation/target/stableUUID/canonicalCandidate/candidateDigest/full reviewed groups/factDigest/engine+config versions/validity; no private proof/tenant facts browser exposure.

Logical group projection exposes complete [type, sorted bookingIds, sorted affectedPersonIds, exact startsAt, endsAt] identity plus full v1/v2 key map, including candidate third or later; use current sole detector, no second detector.

Direct authenticated checked RPC adapter bypasses command validation while supplying otherwise-valid real private detector proof, removes/forges human review, tries both proof substitution directions and client acceptance metadata; exact currently installed overload inventory and ACLs discovered from source/pg_proc.
Genuine signed invalid receipt/group variants for unknown/unrelated/partial/actor/tenant/candidate/target/operation/different-preview rejection, preserving actual production validators.
barriers observe real snapshot/finalize and pg_blocking_pids for facts drift/expiry/revocation; no synthetic replies, fixed delays, or silent skipped stack requirements.

Correlated local test-only fault hooks after actual acceptance and before audit prove reached stage/selected keys, cleaned in finally; baseline bookingSnapshot contains all columns/private create and update command outcomes plus all assignments/conflicts/audit for both tenants.
Bind canonical transport renewal and SQL-clock expiry to actual signer, preserving business decision; authorized historical replay allowed after drift/expiry, denied after role revocation.
Current open count read must deduplicate logical groups, exclude accepted/resolved, preserve unchanged acceptance and PostgreSQL timestamps; seeded microsecond time values for unchanged update.

Production response schema for new editor DTO is not yet present; normalized DTO in this proposal is a test-owned adapter contract. Keep actual output under rawBrowserPayload and assert protected fields never cross public boundary.

confidence_before_generation.evidence: Concrete approved Contract D, ready spec, sole detector full identity/v1-v2 projection, current SQL HMAC/current gate/first replay/final atomic audit and bookingSnapshot all private outcomes inspected before authoring. Unknown editor names remain test-owned binding needs.

playwright_utils.reason: Manifest has no package and suite not Playwright; project fixtures preserved.

pactjs_utils.reason: In-process command/RPC provider has no introduced HTTP or message consumer/provider boundary.

summary: 58 explicit skipped RED command/RPC acceptance cases (57 P0, 1 P1) and one typed fail-closed adapter contract, covering retained INT-001..005 and AC7. No behavioral execution, browser tests, product source, migrations, dependencies or environment changes.
